comment: Strategic merge patch cases (design 3.6). Each case applies patch to a base (or its own original). expected/error come from Kubernetes itself (see source). A case with oursError is one Shearwater refuses on purpose.
source: expected/error produced on 2026-11-10 by k8s.io/apimachinery v0.36.6 strategicpatch.StrategicMergePatch, with panics reported as errors. The generator (a separate Go module, never part of sw) was removed from the repository on 2026-11-11; it is in git history as hack/oracle at commit 483e994. Do not edit expected/error by hand: a new case needs its answer from Kubernetes

cases.name: scalar: set replicas
scalar: null deletes the field
scalar: null for a field that is not there
empty patch changes nothing
map: add and remove label keys
map: null removes the whole map
map: empty object changes nothing
map: $patch replace swaps the map
map: $patch delete removes the object
map: nested object merges key by key
map: new nested object is created
list by key: change one container image
list by key: add a container (appended)
list by key: $patch delete removes one container
list by key: delete an element that is not there
list by key: null removes the whole list
list by key: empty list changes nothing
list by key: $patch replace swaps the list
list by key: element without the merge key is an error
cases.error: map: map[image:x:1] does not contain declared merge key: name

cases.name: list by key: same key twice in the patch
list by key: same key twice in the original
apply: add, delete and reorder containers in one patch
apply: reorder only
apply: element added by someone else keeps its place relative to the rest
apply: setElementOrder does not delete what it leaves out
apply: setElementOrder names an element that exists nowhere
apply: patch element missing from setElementOrder is an error
cases.error:
The order in patch list:
[map[image:d:1 name:d]]
 doesn't match $setElementOrder list:
[map[name:a] map[name:b] map[name:c]]

cases.name: apply: env delete and reorder inside one container
apply: image change plus env removal (the shape kubectl sent in the trace)
env: change a value
env: null removes all variables of one container
env: value null leaves the variable with no value
ports: merge key is containerPort
ports: delete by containerPort
volumeMounts: merge key is mountPath
primitive list: command is replaced whole
primitive list: empty command
primitive list: args replaced on a pod
object list without a merge key: tolerations are replaced whole
stored-only object: probe merges key by key
resources: limits is a map
volumes: merge key is name
volumes: retainKeys swaps the volume source
volumes: without retainKeys both sources remain
volumes: retainKeys must list every key in the patch
strategy: retainKeys drops rollingUpdate when the type changes
strategy: without retainKeys rollingUpdate stays
strategy: retainKeys with a rollingUpdate change
strategy: retainKeys on a field that does not declare it
finalizers: plain list merges (adds the missing one)
finalizers: deleteFromPrimitiveList removes one
finalizers: delete one, add one, set the order
finalizers: null removes them all
finalizers: deleteFromPrimitiveList of a value that is not there
deleteFromPrimitiveList on a list that is replaced whole
ownerReferences: merge key is uid
conditions: merge key is type
pod conditions: merge key is type
service ports: merge key is port
service ports: delete and reorder
service selector: a map, keys merge
directive: unknown $patch value
cases.error: unknown patch type: merge in map: map[$patch:merge type:Recreate]

cases.name: directive: unknown $patch value inside a list
cases.error: merging lists cannot yet be specified in the patch

cases.name: directive: unknown $ key
cases.why: Kubernetes stores the key as a field and the typed decode drops it; Shearwater refuses an unknown directive (design 3.6)

type mismatch: list where an object is
field the schema does not know
setElementOrder for a list that is not a merge list

cases.why: the library panics here; Shearwater answers with an error instead
